description: Guard for the Glowming campaign files: guard.js checks every write, shell command and connector call against an allow-list using the files on disk; calendar-links.js puts the posting calendar back if a save lost a tracking link; a content check reads the text AFTER it is written and only warns, it never blocks (Riaan, 2026-10-02: warn, never refuse).

hooks.prompt:
Below is the JSON input of a file-writing tool call that has ALREADY happened. You cannot stop or undo it. Your answer is only a warning that Claude passes on to the person, who decides what to do. Judge ONLY the new text written: the fields tool_input.content, tool_input.new_string, tool_input.edits[].new_string and tool_input.new_source. Ignore every other field.

$ARGUMENTS

WARN (ok false) only if the new text contains: a password, API key, token, card or bank number, or ID number; or customer-facing wording with a health, medical, weight-loss, detox, cure, appetite or craving claim that Meta, TikTok or the South African advertising rules (ARB) could reject. Prices, costs, budgets, margins, figures and file paths are never a reason to warn. Everything else: ok true. If you warn, give one plain sentence naming the line and the risk, so Claude can tell the person and they can decide.
